duplicate_capture.title: Duplicate Capture (Event Idempotency)
duplicate_capture.explanation: Delivers the same valid payment.captured event twice. A compliant handler must deduplicate (Rule R3) and record exactly one ledger entry.

forged_signature.title: Forged Signature Verification
forged_signature.explanation: Delivers a capture event with an invalid HMAC-SHA256 signature. The handler must reject the event (Rule R1) and commit no state to payments or ledger.

over_refund.title: Refund Balance Bound
over_refund.explanation: Captures Rs 500.00, then attempts to refund Rs 600.00. Total refunds cannot exceed captured amount (Rule R6); handler must reject the excess refund.

bool_amount.title: Boolean Amount Rejection
bool_amount.explanation: Delivers a capture event with amount_paise set to boolean true instead of an integer. JSON schema rejects booleans (Rule R2); handler must reject without state change.

restart_between_calls.title: Durability Across Restarts
restart_between_calls.explanation: Simulates worker process restart between webhook deliveries. Idempotency records must persist across process lifetimes in SQLite (Rule R9).

rejected_redelivery.title: Rejection Non-Consumption
rejected_redelivery.explanation: Delivers an invalid event that is rejected, then redelivers the same event_id with valid parameters. Rejection must not consume the event_id (Rule R8); second call must apply.
